context.title: San Diego Humane Society: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: Lemon Grove — Measure E (Bird Rescue-Only Sales Measure)

positions.statement: Dr. Gary Weitzman (President/CEO, San Diego Humane Society) signed the argument in favor of Lemon Grove Measure E in the San Diego County Voter Information Pamphlets.
